paper_title: Pretreatment-free SERS sensing of microplastics using a self-attention-based neural network on hierarchically porous Ag foams
license: CC-BY-4.0; verified in original Kaggle metadata, version 2
processing_level: Vendor-native JWS spectra prior to author Python background correction, spike removal and normalization. Any acquisition-software processing before file export is not independently established.
decoding_basis: Author jwslib.py: DataInfo format <LLLLLLdddLLLLdddd; indices 5..8 are point count, first coordinate, last coordinate, increment. Y-Data is 32-bit float. Endpoint consistency and finite values checked for every file.
coordinate_unit: Raman shift cm^-1, consistent with author paper and conversion code; original calibrated axis retained.
label_basis: Polymer tokens in original sample directories; AgFAgMC10 substrate directories are analyte-free controls. Full original directory is preserved in metadata.
material_target_status: Targets are polymer/material identities; no unique small-molecule SMILES is assigned. Nylon subtype and polymer chain distribution are not established.

recommended_split: Block original map/sample directories, byte-identical spectra and shared specimen links across modalities. Do not split map pixels randomly. Separate source study from all other tasks for source-level transfer tests. Use duplicate_connected_split_block to keep folders linked by identical spectra in the same fold; these blocks still do not prove preparation independence.
limitations: This import contains five polymer identities. It does not claim all six identities or all branches in the full paper.
All retained map pixels are spectra, not independent samples. Independent preparation and substrate IDs beyond source folders are unavailable.
SPC files and environmental/concentration branches remain in the original archive but are not counted in these two tasks.
Directory-derived labels describe the sample composition; an individual map pixel may contain no detectable polymer signal.
Raman reference spectra and SERS mixture spectra share one source study and may share parent materials; they are not independent source studies.
Exact repeated CSV spectra are listed in identical_spectrum_clusters. Keep each cluster in one validation fold; any conflicting-label clusters require review or exclusion.
